arguments.title: Falcon Distribution (Revised)
arguments.subtitle: Source-backed analysis. Assumptions remain subject to diligence.

sections.heading: Executive summary
paragraphs: Revision applied per 2026-09-01 notice: Suite 002 is now active with a $225 monthly rent increase; new certified roll date 2026-09-01. Initial sizing rate increased by 75 bps to 7.75%; cap rate increased by 25 bps to 6.50%. All other rules unchanged.

Revised UW results: Underwritten NOI before reserves $905,100; NCF after reserves $902,700. At a 6.50% cap, value is $13.92 million. With 30-year amortization and 7.75% sizing rate, DSCR now constrains maximum loan to about $8.40 million. After 1% origination, $45k closing, and $7.80 million payoff, net cash out is approximately $0.47 million.

sections.heading: What changed and why
paragraphs: Revised certified rent roll (2026-09-01) supersedes prior roll; Suite 002 moved from active to active with a $225 increase in scheduled monthly rent, raising all-suite monthly GPR from $116,900 to $117,125 and annual GPR from $1,402,800 to $1,405,500.

Revision notice directed increasing the INITIAL SIZING RATE by 75 bps (from 7.00% to 7.75%) and the capitalization rate by 25 bps (from 6.25% to 6.50%). These changes reduce value and increase the annual debt constant, lowering DSCR-constrained proceeds.

sections.heading: Property and suite mix
paragraphs: Type mapping unchanged: A = Small, B = Standard, C = Large. Counts unchanged. Unit 001 monthly rent remains $14,450 per executed lease and roll. Suite 002 monthly rent increased by $225 to $14,825 and is active as of 2026-09-01; other suites unchanged.

sections.heading: Lease and occupancy analysis
paragraphs: Occupancy by units and area remains 7 of 8 (87.5%) and 154,060 SF of 176,060 SF (~87.5%). No near-term rollover; all expirations remain 2029-08-31.
Archive roll still shows prior rates for comparison only; revised certified roll controls as of 2026-09-01.

sections.heading: Historical versus underwritten financials
paragraphs: T12 actuals unchanged. Revised UW uses new GPR $1,405,500, 5% loss, $2,800 other income, mgmt 3%, reserves $300/suite.
UW NOI before reserves increases modestly to $905,100 vs. $902,612 prior; NCF after reserves $902,700.

sections.heading: Debt sizing and sources/uses
paragraphs: Constraints unchanged: 65% LTV, 1.25x DSCR, 9% debt yield. Sizing rate now 7.75% raises the annual debt constant to ~8.5969%.
At revised value $13.92MM, 65% LTV is ~$9.05MM. DSCR at 7.75% limits to ~$8.40MM; debt yield is ~$10.03MM. Maximum loan remains DSCR-constrained at ~$8.40MM.
Sources/uses at revised proceeds: loan ~$8.4002MM; less 1% origination, $45k closing, $7.80MM payoff → net cash out ≈ $0.471MM.

sections.heading: Risks and diligence status
paragraphs: Risk assessments unchanged except sizing floor vs. note: floor binding remains present and the higher sizing rate further tightens DSCR. Pending-in-occupancy headline risk persists conceptually but certified detail controls.
Refinance shortfall remains absent at the stated $7.8MM payoff; there is still positive cash out, albeit smaller.

rows: Absent given $7.8MM payoff; positive net cash out

sections.heading: Source notes
paragraphs: Revision notice: 2026-09-01 roll supersedes; Suite 002 +$225 monthly; raise initial sizing rate +75 bps; raise cap rate +25 bps.
Revised certified rent roll 2026-09-01: unit counts, areas, statuses, monthly rents, expirations.
Original instructions and other source documents remain as previously cited and unchanged.
